items.topic: C1 lateral mass screw — internal carotid artery avoidance
items.destination_intent: Spine OITE — 2026 (3b4097df-8115-8108-8fcb-cd7c7e15b379), C1–C2 screw neurovascular anatomy
items.teaching_point_placement: Immediately below the C1 lateral mass screw carotid-avoidance explanation, adjacent to the existing C1–C2 transarticular neurovascular comparison
items.caption_intent: Exact user-supplied enlarged axial CT from Q13 #871073. White arrows identify the internal carotid arteries anterior/anterolateral to the C1 lateral masses. A modest medial trajectory (10° in this OITE question) directs an anteriorly exiting bicortical screw tip away from the carotids. Individualize trajectory and length to CT anatomy; excessive medial angulation endangers the canal.
